params.name: apiKey
params.description: Personal API key for the ipify Geolocation product.

params.name: ipAddress
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up. Defaults to the requester's IP when omitted and no `domain`/`email` is supplied.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name whose A/AAAA record should be resolved and looked up.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address whose MX server IP should be looked up.

params.name: reverseIp
params.description: When `1`, include up to five reverse-DNS associated domains in the response.

params.name: escapedUnicode
params.description: When `1`, leave Unicode characters in escaped form rather than decoding them.

items.docs: Look up an IP, domain, or email and return its country-level geolocation and ISP. Costs 1 credit per successful request.
